giving thanks for the harvest at harvest time we give thanks to god for all the gifts we have been given, and we also give thanks for the work of the farmers. thanks to those who have donated to the display in both church es. the warehouse charity is very grateful for the fruit and vegetables already received. items donated this weekend will also be distributed to the warehouse. relics of the apostles & martyrs the parish of newtownards & comber has the privilege of being the custodian of relics of the holy apostles, martrys of the 2nd & 3rd centuries, in addition to other relics on temporary loan to the parish . as we will celebrate the feast day of the holy apostles saints simon and jude this coming wednesday, 28th october, the relics will be on display in the reliquary in st patrick’s church. they will also be on display for the feast of all saints 31st oct/1st november. those attending mass are invited to venerate the relics after mass. we ask for the prayers of the apostles and martyrs and all the saints. friendship club the club meets in st patrick’s parish centre, newtownards every wednesday 2pm-4pm. do come along to form and renew friendships. the club provides many opportunities for company, conversation and activities with many events organised throughout the year. please spread the word-invite friends along too!

in support of human life during this week we are asked to pray for the protection of life: -let us pray for all those with disabilities, including the un born. we pray for protection for them and their mothers from the pressures of assisted suicide and abortion, and that they would instead experie nce overwhelming support from all who surround them. forthcoming date for eucharistic adoration wednesday 25th november in st patrick’s church 10am-4pm preparing for the month of the holy souls november dead lists are available after mass this weekend. please take a list home to record the names of your deceased loved on es, family, friends, neighbours and particularly those who have no living relatives to pray for them. please return if possible before the beginning of november. upon return, the envelopes will be o pened, read, and place near the altar for the celebration of masses during november. the offerings enclosed are used to support the priests o f the diocese. feast of the holy souls-a special day of prayer and suffrage for t he deceased. mass will be celebrated in st patrick’s at 9.30am, and in our lady of the visitation, comber at 7.30pm. annual masses for the dead on the weekend of 7th/8th november we will include in the masses those whose funerals have taken place in the churches of the parish over the last twelve months. we will also welcome their family members and pray god’s consolation for them. on wednesday 4th november at 7pm in st patrick’s church, mass will be offered in memory of all our deceased children. as in previous years, their names will be placed discreetly in front of the altar. the parish bereavement care team invite those who have suffered the tragic loss of a child, regardless of age, to contact them in confidence on

, or to speak to bronagh or aine , if they would like their child’s name to be included. in addition to the november dead lists placed near the altar, parishioners may like to consider displaying memoriam cards of loved ones on the display boards in the churches. the display is an expression of our love for the deceased, helping others to reme mber them, and encourages prayer for the happy | thank you, lord, for the gift of life itself, for my birth, for my family and friends, for all those who help me in life, for the gift of those | meet each day, for every act of kindness | receive. | thank you lord, for the beauty of creation, for things in nature that give me joy, for the wonder of every living thing. | thank you, lord, for creating us all in your image, for giving us hearts that can love you, for the goodness of others, for those who help the poor and needy, for those who show consideration, for being able to forgive like you, for fortitude through life’s trials. for your glory shining through those seeking to make the world a better place. | thank you lord for sharing your life with us, for suffering for our sakes, for giving yourself up on the cross, for the splendour of your holiness, for loving us, now and always.
